company_description: C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides freight transportation and related logistics and supply chain services in the United States and internationally. It operates in two segments, North American Surface Transportation and Global Forwarding. The company offers transportation and logistics services, such as truckload; less than truckload transportation brokerage services, which include the shipment of single or multiple pallets of freight; intermodal transportation that comprises the shipment service of freight in containers or trailers by a combination of truck and rail; and non-vessel operating common carrier and freight forwarding services, as well as organizes indirect air carrier and freight forwarder providing door-to-door services. It also provides customs brokerage services; and other logistics services, such as fee-based managed, warehousing, supply chain consulting and optimization services, and other services. In addition, the company is involved in the buying, selling, and/or marketing of fresh fruits, vegetables, and other value-added perishable items under the Robinson Fresh trade name. risks.title: Economic recession and volume decline
risks.summary: An economic recession would reduce freight volumes, particularly in key customer sectors (retail, automotive, technology). This would decrease growth opportunities and operating results.
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in Item 1A with strong language ('material and adverse impact', 'could cause us to not reach our long-term growth goals'). Stable but structural trend in the sector. Macro-economic category = high weight for carrier.

risks.title: Third-party carrier failure risk
risks.summary: CHRW relies on independent third-party carriers to deliver goods. If these providers go bankrupt or cannot provide sufficient capacity, CHRW may fail to meet its customer commitments.
risks.score_rationale: Major risk at the core of the business model with strong language ('materially and adversely affected'). Positioned in the central section of operational risks. Stable trend but exacerbated by industry shortages. Critical for logistics provider.

risks.title: Technological disruption and AI competition
risks.summary: Competitors are rapidly adopting AI and automation to improve efficiency. If CHRW fails to keep pace technologically, its costs will rise and competitiveness will decline.
risks.score_rationale: New risk explicitly amplified ('accelerated adoption of automation and AI', 'disruptive technologies'). Strong language on competitive impact ('materially and adversely affected'). Positioned in the central section. Technology = high weight for logistics broker.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risk and IT disruptions
risks.summary: CHRW's internally developed IT systems, which rely on third parties, are vulnerable to cyberattacks, ransomware, and outages. A major attack could paralyze operations and cause customer loss.
risks.score_rationale: Detailed and explicit risk with very strong language ('material service outages', 'could result in service interruptions'). Internally developed systems = increased vulnerability. Cybersecurity = high regulatory and operational weight. Trend up (increasing sophistication).

risks.title: Customs tariffs and trade restrictions
risks.summary: Customs tariffs imposed in 2025 have already disrupted the Global Forwarding segment. New trade restrictions could increase costs, reduce volumes, and complicate operations.
risks.score_rationale: New and updated risk (2025) with observed impact ('impacted our Global Forwarding business in 2025'). Strong language ('materially affected'). Positioned in the international section. Geopolitics = high weight for global operator.

risks.title: Dependency on pricing and sourcing of fresh products
risks.summary: The sourcing segment depends on the availability and pricing of fresh produce, which are affected by weather and growing conditions. CHRW sometimes advances funds to producers, with risk of non-repayment.
risks.score_rationale: Segment-specific risk with strong language ('materially and adversely affected'). Positioned in the business risks section. Stable trend but structural volatility. Moderate weight due to specialized segment.

risks.title: International regulatory compliance risk
risks.summary: CHRW's international operations must comply with complex laws (OFAC sanctions, FCPA anti-corruption, GDPR data protection). Non-compliance could result in penalties and operational restrictions.
risks.score_rationale: Detailed risk (OFAC, FCPA, GDPR) with moderate language ('reputational harm, substantial penalties'). Positioned in international operations section. Trend up (continuous regulatory evolution). Regulation = high weight.

risks.title: Logistics talent attraction and retention
risks.summary: CHRW depends on qualified logistics professionals. Macroeconomic factors make hiring and retention more costly and difficult, affecting model flexibility.
risks.score_rationale: Important operational risk with moderate language ('cannot guarantee'). Positioned in enterprise risks section. Trend up (tight labor market). Moderate weight as manageable through HR policies.
